Lajɔli waati dɔ kɔnɔ bɛ cikanw minnu bɛ yen ani minnu bɛna na minɛ; cili ta tuguni bɛ cikanw minnu bɛ makɔnɔsɛbɛn kɔnɔ ci lajɛ kokura sisan. Cikan min ci daminɛna, o tɛ se ka lasegin, ani cikan min ka ci nɔfɛko ma dafa, o bɛ se ka ci siɲɛ fila. Filiw minnu bɛ to yen ani cikanw minnu sera lajɛli hakɛ dan na bɛ mara sɛgɛsɛgɛli kama. Cikanw minnu ci ma ɲɛ lajɛli kokura bɛ lajɛli kura daminɛ, wa a bɛ lajɔli waati dɔ kɔnɔ min bɛ yen mara.

Kolɔnw bɛ kalan u ka angilɛkan tɔgɔw la (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ni i ka jatebila bɛ kan wɛrɛ kɛ, kuntitiri sira tɔgɔ yɛlɛma ka kɛ angilɛkan ye fɔlɔ. Column bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani Lane bɛ kɛ siraw ye; tigiw, taamasiyɛnw, kulɛri, donw, hakilinaw ani faden sirajɛw b'u nɔ mara, ani Priority, Size, Type ani kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.

Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, ClickUp lisitiw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka baara fitininw, baarakɛlaw, taamasiyɛnw, donw, ɲɛfɛrɔ ani waati ye.

Tabali lajɛcogo ka jɛkulu dilancogo bɛ kɛ lisiw ye, sugandili cogo tɔw bɛ kɛ taamasiyɛnw ye, sɛbɛnni ani taamasi da-yɔrɔw bɛ kɛ ɲɛfɔli ani sɛgɛsɛgɛli sɛbɛn ye, ani hakilinaw bɛ mara. Jaw ani filen faralenw tɛ ladon.

import-board-instruction-linear: Linear kɔnɔ, gɛlɛyaw labɔ i n'a fɔ CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, walima lajɛyɔrɔ dɔ ka labɔli), o kɔ CSV don. Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, jɛkuluw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, ani gɛlɛyaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka baarakɛla, taamasiyɛnw, donw, gɛlɛya faden, ɲɛfɛrɔ, jateminɛ, porozɛ ani tasuma ye.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Bila markdown baara lisi (cogo min markdown-kanban minɛnw i n'a fɔ Obsidian Kanban be baara kɛ a la): "## Lisi tɔgɔ" kunben, ni "- [ ]"/"- [x]" fɛn dow ye a jukɔrɔ. Kunben bɛ kɛ lisiw ye ani fɛnw bɛ kɛ karatiw ye; bullet lisi nɔgɔman min tɛ checkbox sɔrɔ fana bɛ don, i n'a fɔ karati dayɛlɛlen.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MeisterTask kɔnɔ, porozɛ tɔgɔ digi, Export project sugandi ka CSV labɔ, o kɔ k'a don. Yɔrɔw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka kunnafoniw, waati laban, baarakɛla ani taamasiyɛnw ye; baara dafalenw b'u dafali don mara. CSV min sɛbɛnna MeisterTask yɛrɛ ka donni kama, o fana bɛ baara kɛ.
import-board-instruction-monday: monday.com kɔnɔ, walan menu da wuli, More actions ni Export board to Excel sugandi (ni kunnafoni kuraw ni fɛn fitininw ye ni i b'a fɛ), o kɔ o .xlsx fisiye sugandi. Status kolɔn bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani kuluw bɛ kɛ siraw ye; mɔgɔw, donw, waati sira ani taamasiyɛnw b'u nɔ mara, kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye ani kunnafoni kuraw bɛ kɛ hakilinaw ye.
import-board-instruction-notion: Notion kɔnɔ, kunnafonimarayɔrɔ da wuli i n'a fɔ ɲɛ dafalen, ••• ni Export sugandi, Markdown & CSV sugandi, ani .zip fisiye min jiginna, o sugandi, walima kunnafonimarayɔrɔ CSV kelen min bɛ a kɔnɔ, walima o CSV don. Kolɔn min tɔgɔ ye Status, o bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye (ni o tɛ yen, kolɔn fɔlɔ min bɛ i n'a fɔ sugandili, o bɛ kɛ, ani donni rapɔɔri b'a fɔ min don); sirandaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u tɔgɔ, taamasiyɛnw i n'a fɔ labelw, mɔgɔw i n'a fɔ tɔndenw, donw, ani ɲɛ sɛbɛnni i n'a fɔ ɲɛfɔli; kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye. Jɛɲɔgɔnyaw, jaw ani nɔrɔlenw tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Nullboard kɔnɔ, walan da wuli, Export this board... sugandi menu kɔnɔ, .nbx fisiye da wuli sɛbɛnni labɛnnan kɔnɔ ka a kɔnɔkofɛnw don. Lisitiw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani kunnafoniw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye: kunnafoni ka sira fɔlɔ ye karti tɔgɔ ye ani a tɔ ye a ɲɛfɔli ye. Kunnafoni kɛnɛ bɛ taamasiyɛn raw sɔrɔ. Fisiye min kɔnɔ walan caman bɛ, o ka walan fɔlɔ dɔrɔn bɛ don.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Obsidian kɔnɔ, Kanban walan fisiye da wuli i n'a fɔ Markdown (walima .md fisiye da wuli sɛbɛnni labɛnnan kɔnɔ), o kɔ a bɛɛ don. Siraw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ni u ka karti dan ye, kartiw b'u ka taamasiyɛnw, donw, ɲɛfɛrɔ, forow ani lajɛli lisiti mara, ani Archive bɛ kɛ karti bilalenw ye marayɔrɔ la.
import-board-instruction-openproject: OpenProject work-packages lajɛlen JSON nɔrɔ yan (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, work packages bɛ kɛ karataw ye.
import-board-instruction-opml: OPML layidu don, i n'a fɔ Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ani layidu labɛnna minɛn wɛrɛw b'a labɔ cogo min na. Fɛn minnu bɛ sanfɛ kɔrɔ, olu bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, u denw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni kunnafoni ye ɲɛfɔli ye, ani fɛn minnu bɛ jukɔrɔ kosɛbɛ, olu bɛ kɛ lajɛli lisitiw ye. Fɛn dafalenw bɛ don i n'a fɔ fɛn banninw.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Org mode fisiye don, i n'a fɔ Emacs, Orgzly walima Beorg b'a sɛbɛn cogo min na. Kuntitiri minnu bɛ sanfɛ kɔrɔ, olu bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, ani kuntitiri filanan bɛ kɛ kartiw ye. TODO ni DONE, ɲɛfɛrɔw, taamasiyɛnw, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ani CLOSED bɛ mara, ani lajɛli butɔnw ni kuntitiri jukɔrɔlenw bɛ kɛ lajɛli lisitiw ye.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Pivotal Tracker kɔnɔ, porozɛ ka MORE tabulo da wuli ka Export CSV sugandi (walima maana dɔw sugandi ka Bulk Actions, CSV sugandi), o kɔ CSV don. Maana cogoya kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ lisiti ye ani maanaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka suguya ni taamasiyɛnw, tigiw, ɲinibaga, donw, hakilinaw, baaraw ani bolilankolonw ye; Estimate bɛ kɛ Story points ye ani tasumaw bɛ kɛ sprintw ye.
import-board-instruction-plane: Plane kɔnɔ, Workspace Settings da wuli, Exports sugandi, porozɛw labɔ i n'a fɔ JSON, CSV walima Excel ka .zip fisiye jigin, o kɔ o fisiye sugandi, walima fisiye kelen min bɛ a kɔnɔ, walima JSON walima CSV don. Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, porozɛw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, ani gɛlɛyaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka dɔnnikɛtaamasiyɛn, faden, baarakɛlaw, taamasiyɛnw, donw, sirajɛw ani hakilinaw ye; ɲɛfɛrɔ, jateminɛ, tasuma ani module bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye. Plane ka labɔli tɛ ni ɲɛfɔliw walima nɔrɔlenw ye, o la u tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Quire kɔnɔ, porozɛ menu da wuli ka Export CSV sugandi, o kɔ CSV don. Cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka baara fitininw ye i n'a fɔ karti denw, baarakɛlaw, taamasiyɛnw i n'a fɔ labelw, daminɛ, laban ani dafali donw, ɲɛfɔli ani ɲɛfɛrɔ i n'a fɔ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen. Hakilinaw ni nɔrɔlenw tɛ Quire ka CSV kɔnɔ.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Redmine kɔnɔ, porozɛ ka Issues da wuli, Also available in: CSV sugandi lisiti duguma, kolɔnw sugandi (All columns, ni Description ye) ka a labɔ, o kɔ CSV don. Redmine bɛ kolɔnw tɔgɔ da i ka kan na, o la i ka kan sigi angilɛkan na My account kɔnɔ sani i ka a labɔ. Cogoya kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ lisiti ye ani gɛlɛyaw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni tracker ye i n'a fɔ taamasiyɛn, baarakɛla, sɛbɛnbaga, donw, baara faden ani gɛlɛya sirilenw; ɲɛfɛrɔ, suguya, version laɲinilen, waati jatelen, % Done ani foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Super Productivity kɔnɔ, Settings da wuli, o kɔ Sync & Backup, Export Data sugandi ka sp-backup .json fisiye kɔnɔkofɛnw don. Porozɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ sira ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye To Do, In Progress, Backlog walima Done kɔnɔ, ni u ka kunnafoniw, taamasiyɛnw, waati laban, waati min tɛmɛna ani baara fitininw ye; baara bilalenw marayɔrɔ la bɛ kɛ karti bilalenw ye marayɔrɔ la.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Taiga kɔnɔ, Admin > Project > Export da wuli ka porozɛ kopi jigin (.json.gz fisiye dabɔ fɔlɔ), o kɔ a ka JSON don. User story cogoyaw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, user storyw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye ni u ka baaraw ye i n'a fɔ baara fitininw, epicw ni gɛlɛyaw b'u yɛrɛ ka siraw sɔrɔ, ani sprintw, taamasiyɛnw, hakilinaw ani jogo kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw bɛ na fana. Nɔrɔlenw tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Tasks.org kɔnɔ, Settings, Backups da wuli ka Export tasks sugandi, o kɔ o .json fisiye kɔnɔkofɛnw don. Lisitiw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka kunnafoniw, taamasiyɛnw, donw, hakilinaw ani baara fitininw ye; baara dafalenw b'u dafali don mara, ani ɲɛfɛrɔ bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnen ye.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: task export ka bɔli nɔrɔ yan: JSON lisi dɔ walima baara kelen sɛbɛnci kelen-kelen bɛɛ la. Baara minnu banna, olu bɛ taa Done la, project ani priority bɛ kɛ taamasiyɛnw ye, annotations bɛ kɛ hakilina ye, depends bɛ kɛ da baara minnu bɛ baliya kɛ olu kan ye.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Teamwork.com kɔnɔ, Excel baara donni misali fa (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ka a mara i n'a fɔ .xlsx, o kɔ o fisiye sugandi. Baara lisitiw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye; baara min bɛ daminɛ ni -, # walima > ye, o bɛ kɛ a sanfɛ baara ka baara fitini ye (--, ## walima >> ka jigin dakun kelen). Baarakɛlaw, donw ani taamasiyɛnw b'u nɔ mara; Priority, Estimated time ani Complete bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: TickTick kɔnɔ, Settings, Account, Backup & Import da wuli ka kopi dɔ dilan, o kɔ CSV fisiye don. TickTick lisiti kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ kɛ sira ye ani a ka kolɔnw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye; baaraw b'u ka taamasiyɛnw, donw, lajɛli lisiti, ɲɛfɛrɔ ani baara fitininw mara.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Todo.txt dosiye dɔ nɔrɔ yan: baara kelen sinsan kelen kelen bɛɛ la, i n'a fɔ todo.txt porogaramu ni porogaramu minnu bɛ bɛn a ma b'a sɛbɛn cogo min na. Baara bannenw ("x") bɛ taa Banna la, +project ni @context bɛ kɛ taamasiyɛnw ye, (A) bɛ kɛ baara fɔlɔ taamasiyɛn ye, due: ni t: bɛ kɛ laban don ni daminɛ don ye.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Vikunja kɔnɔ, Settings da wuli, Data Export sugandi ka .zip fisiye min ci i ma jigin, o kɔ o fisiye sugandi, walima data.json min bɛ a kɔnɔ, o don. Kanban bɔɔrɔw bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka taamasiyɛnw, baarakɛlaw, donw, ɲɛfɔli, baara lisitiw i n'a fɔ lajɛli lisitiw ani hakilinaw ye; ɲɛfɛrɔ, kɛmɛsarada dafalen ani dafalen bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye. Nɔrɔlenw tɛ don.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Wrike kɔnɔ, porozɛ walima kɛsu labɔ Excel la, walima Wrike ka Excel donni misali fa, o kɔ o .xlsx fisiye sugandi. Kɛsu ni porozɛ siraw bɛ kɛ siraw ye, Status bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye ani baaraw bɛ kɛ kartiw ye, ni u ka Key, baara faden, baarakɛlaw, daminɛ ni laban donw, sirilenw ani ɲɛfɔli ye; Priority, Duration ani kolɔn wɛrɛw bɛ kɛ foro kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnenw ye.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: ZenKit lisiti labɔli JSON nɔrɔ yan ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages bɛ kɛ lisitiw ye, items bɛ kɛ karataw ye.

r-workflow-help: Daminɛla ni kɛwale sama ka u bila dilanbaga kɔnɔ, o kɔ sariya fara a kan. Kɛwale dɔ sama ka a bila sariya min bɛ yen kan ka a ka baara yɛlɛma.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Wrike baara taabolo ye cogoyaw lisiti ye, u kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ Active, Completed, Deferred walima Cancelled kulu kɔnɔ. Labɔli bɛ nin walan ka lisitiw sɛbɛn i n'a fɔ kelen, min tɔgɔ ye walan tɔgɔ ye, JSON kɔnɔ Wrike ka API bɛ min segin baara taabolow kama: o baara taabolo dilan Wrike kɔnɔ sani i ka walan ka Wrike Excel labɔli don, walasa a ka cogoyaw ka sigi. Donni bɛ o JSON kalan min donna sanfɛ, ka bɔ WeKan walima Wrike ka GET /workflows la, ka don walan sugandilen kɔnɔ: cogoya min tɛ ni lisiti ye, o bɛ kɛ lisiti ye, ani sariya dɔ bɛ karti taamasiyɛn ko a dafara ni a lataara Completed walima Cancelled cogoya la, ani ko a ma dafa Active walima Deferred cogoya la. Wrike yɛrɛ ka sariya automatikiw tɛ se ka labɔ Wrike la.
